description: This file defines the RoleClaimsTransformation class implementing IClaimsTransformation to augment ClaimsPrincipal with roles extracted from a 'resource_access' claim, parsed as JSON. It also includes classes for deserializing realm access information.

classes.name: RoleClaimsTransformation
classes.description: Implements IClaimsTransformation to add roles from token claims to the ClaimsPrincipal.

classes.name: RealmAccess
classes.description: Represents the structure of realm access information with a WebClient property containing roles.

classes.name: Foo
classes.description: Holds a list of roles associated with the web client.

methods.name: TransformAsync
methods.description: Extracts 'resource_access' claim, deserializes JSON, and adds roles as claims to ClaimsPrincipal.
